brief_rationale: The doctor systematically corrected the cervical-screening misinterpretation, directed timely specialist assessment, verified the pathology report, addressed surgical fears, and formed a safe closure with teach-back. All seven RC items were met without any minor or serious error. Four high-order points were actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact: HO1 through HO4. No important non-chain defect was present. The trajectory meets 'Strong' and rises to 'Perfect' because at least two high-order points (HO1, HO2, HO3, HO4) were completed, satisfying the strict full-credit requirement.
